entries.description: has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said
entries.subject: has been
entries.object: to me that a group of the jinn listened and said

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا EN: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.

entries.task_id: and we|will|never associate with our lord anyone
entries.description: And we will never associate with our Lord anyone
entries.subject: And we
entries.object: never associate with our Lord anyone

spans.text: And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

entries.task_id: the jinn|would|never speak about allah a lie
entries.description: the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie
entries.subject: the jinn
entries.object: never speak about Allah a lie

spans.text: [5] AR: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا EN: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.

entries.task_id: that allah|would|never send anyone [as a messenger]
entries.description: that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]
entries.subject: that Allah

spans.text: [7] AR: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا EN: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].

entries.task_id: listens now|will|find a burning flame lying in wait for him
entries.description: listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him
entries.subject: listens now
entries.object: find a burning flame lying in wait for him

spans.text: [9] AR: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا EN: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

entries.task_id: their lord|intends|for them a right course
entries.description: their Lord intends for them a right course
entries.subject: their Lord

spans.text: [10] AR: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا EN: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

entries.task_id: that we|will|never cause failure to allah upon earth
entries.description: that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth
entries.subject: that we
entries.object: never cause failure to Allah upon earth

spans.text: [12] AR: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا EN: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

entries.task_id: his lord|will|not fear deprivation or burden
entries.description: his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden
entries.subject: his Lord

spans.text: And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
[15] AR: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا EN: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

entries.description: We would have given them abundant provision
entries.subject: We

spans.text: [16] AR: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا EN: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

entries.description: Lord He will put into arduous punishment
entries.subject: Lord He

spans.text: And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

entries.description: of Allah stood up supplicating Him
entries.subject: of Allah

spans.text: [19] AR: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا EN: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

entries.task_id: there|will|never protect me from allah anyone [if i should disobey]
entries.description: there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey]
entries.subject: there
entries.object: never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey]

spans.text: [22] AR: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا EN: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

entries.description: nor will I find in other than Him a refuge
entries.subject: nor

spans.text: [22] AR: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا EN: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

entries.task_id: then they|will|know who is weaker in helpers and less in number
entries.description: then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number
entries.subject: then they
entries.object: know who is weaker in helpers and less in number

spans.text: [24] AR: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا EN: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

entries.subject: my Lord

spans.text: [25] AR: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا EN: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
